{{Quote|The filthy lies of the enemy describe us as cowards. We will show our ferocity as they suffer. Our heartless droids are unstoppable. Imagine how tenacious we are when guarding our soil and riches.|Nute Gunray|<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" />}}
The '''Neimoidian Home Defense Legions''' were a collection of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]-aligned [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] units assigned to protect<ref name="Neimoidian Home Defense Legions">{{CSWECite|II|368|Neimoidian Home Defense Legions}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] and the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]]&mdash;[[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], [[Deko Neimoidia/Legends|Deko Neimoidia]], and [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]]<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" />&mdash;during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Interestingly, the [[Legion/Legends|legions]] were comprised of Neimoidian conscripts and not [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]],<ref name="Neimoidian Home Defense Legions" /> each carrying an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] and wearing a pair of [[Data goggles/Legends|data goggles]].<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology note">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the zero point in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], to 35:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system. ''The Essential Atlas'' also places the [[Battle of Selaggis]] on 43:2:28 and the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]] on 43:3:21. ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' and ''The Essential Atlas'' both place the Battle of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' also places the Battle of [[Selaggis system/Legends|Selaggis]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], confirming the placement of the division between each Galactic Standard Calendar [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as the third [[Standard month/Legends|month]] in the Great ReSynchronization year. Thus, there is a two-month gap between the two dating systems, and the first two months of a GrS year are the last two of the preceding Galactic Standard Calendar year. According to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_2.html|RM&S; Debates Calendar Reform}}, the Great ReSynchronization was instituted 13 years prior to the article's publication on 13:2:28. Using this information and the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin's]] GRS date allow us to determine that the Great ReSynchronization was instituted in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]] and date the aforementioned article to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Thus, there is a total difference of 35 years and 2 months between the two systems.<br />Based on the provided information, 14:10:05 occurred in the year [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Office of the General]] of the Separatist Army issued a decree increasing [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] security, prompted by recent incursions into [[Neimoidian space]] by Republic scouting missions. In response, the Neimoidian Home Defense Legions doubled their conscription rate and called up all reservist for active duty<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" /> to protect Neimoidia and her purse worlds from the war.<ref name="Cato Neimoidia">{{DB|location|catoneimoidia|Cato Neimoidia}}</ref> The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] 's [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]], [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], made a general address to [[Gender/Legends|his]] people regarding the decree in<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" /> Neimoidia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Koto-Si/Legends|Koto-Si]] while flanked by a trio of Neimoidian conscripts. On [[Great ReSynchronization|14:10:05]], both the [[General/Legends|General's]] decree and [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] Gunray's address were reported on by [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] in an article entitled "Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate."<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neimoidian Home Defense Legions first appeared in the [[HoloNet News (Insider)|HoloNet News]] article "[[CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:10:05 Edition]]," written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 71|''Star Wars Insider'' 71]] in [[2003]].<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate" />
